transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in today?

I don’t know… I just can’t really make myself do anything anymore. I mostly sit in my room, wearing the same clothes, and I stopped doing stuff I used to like… knitting, journaling, walking. My mom asks what’s wrong, but I barely feel like answering.
Have you lost interest in activities you used to enjoy, like knitting or journaling?
Yeah… I guess I have. I don’t really knit or write in my journal anymore. I used to go walking too, but now I mostly just sit in my room. I can’t really make myself do it.
Have you been feeling guilty or like you’re not good enough lately?
I don’t really know… I haven’t thought about it like that. I just feel kind of… blank, mostly.
Have you been feeling like you’re not good enough or felt guilty about things lately?
I… I don’t really know. I don’t think about it much. I mostly just feel kind of empty, I guess.
Have you been feeling down or depressed most of the time, almost every day?
I’m not really sure. I don’t think of it as depressed exactly… just kind of there, I guess.
Have you felt down or sad most of the day, nearly every day?
I don’t know… sad isn’t really the word I’d use. I just feel kind of numb most of the time.
Have you had trouble focusing on things or found it hard to think clearly lately?
I’m not sure… I guess sometimes it’s hard to follow things, but I haven’t really been paying attention to it.
Have you noticed that you're thinking more slowly than usual or have trouble making decisions?
I don’t really know. I haven’t noticed it like that… decisions are just kind of hard sometimes, I guess.
Have you completely lost interest in everything, like there’s nothing that can make you feel even a little bit interested or happy?

Kind of… I mean, I mostly just sit in my room now. I don’t really do the things I used to, like knitting or writing in my journal or going for walks. I just… can’t make myself do anything. Even answering my mom feels like too much sometimes.
Is there anything at all that used to bring you pleasure, even a little, that you don’t feel anything from now?

Yeah… knitting, I guess. And writing in my journal. I used to go for walks too. Now I just sit in my room, usually in the same clothes, and I don’t really feel anything about it. I just can’t make myself do it. Even when my mom asks me what’s wrong, I barely answer.
Have you completely stopped taking pleasure or interest in absolutely everything, even things you used to really enjoy?
Pretty much, yeah. I just… don’t do anything anymore. I sit in my room, same clothes, and I don’t knit or write or go on walks like I used to. Even when my mom asks me what’s wrong, I barely answer.
